protocol.massModel: Uniform enclosed solid: the single connected solid that remains after A1 debris exclusion; not printed walls/infill.
protocol.collisionModel: Original-mesh convex hull against a flat plane only; exact source-mesh mass and inertia. No support, fragment, tray or neighbouring-object collisions.
protocol.initialConditions: Original generated print pose, zero velocity, no push or artificial perturbation.
protocol.interpretation: Qualitative numerical replay, not a real print or the paper benchmark. Angle threshold describes rotation, not a printability guarantee.
protocol.amendment: A1 (2026-11-23, fixed before any project-model outcome was seen): (a) connected components with less than 0.1% of the enclosed volume are excluded as meshing debris, uniformly for all models; any larger extra component keeps a model unsupported; (b) the koala and kangaroo display-source meshes (3MF) were added to the input list.

sourceType: Full-resolution render_data mesh from the 2026-11-18 print set
